title: The model's first step no longer waits for the turn's seal: the first call that may write the site waits instead; pre-step reads run side by side; stable context goes before the customer's words
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/turn-open-hold.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/step-order.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/pre-step-overlap.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for each of the tests named in run.tests.
expect: Every named test reports ok and the run exits 0 with nothing failed, cancelled or skipped.

Step 1 of a conversation enters while the turn door (POST /turn, the seal) has not answered; a read (read, tracy_site page.text) runs at once; a write (tracy_site content.replace, bash) waits until the door answers.
A later turn's step still waits for the door and carries the undone notice right after the person's message.
An open with no answer within its budget lets the held write go at the budget and logs 'not opened'; a cancelled call is let go at once.
The doors hear open, then steer, then close (moment), even when the step did not wait for the open.
Only tools that cannot write run beside the seal: dsh readers, read-class tracy_site actions, EmDash read tools; shells, every file write, prepare actions, build/design tools and unknown tools wait.

On step 1, agent-instructions, runtime-context, skill-catalog and the site facts come before the customer's message and are the same bytes for two conversations on one site; per-turn notices come after it; no step re-sends or reorders a logged message.
The design pull and the site-changed read are asked together: each door sees the other asked before it answers.
evidence: Harness profile 09/10/2026 (~/tracy-bench-work/harness-opt/profile.md §1, §5): turn/start to step 1 was 15.7 s (WordPress) / 15.6 s (Joomla) / 3.1 s (EmDash) median on the flow-D suite, because the pre-step waited for POST /turn (seal, up to 12 s at the door, 15 s at the host) and then three reads in series; step 1 sent a median 3,654 uncached tokens because ~12.6k stable characters stood after the customer's message.
fence: packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/src/host/turn-record.mjs: createTurnBook enter/writeReady/close (the chain), openMayNameUndone; turn.mjs: callMayWriteSite; index.ts: watchHost pre-step and tools/pre-execute. packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/step-order.mjs: orderStepMessages; index.ts: the prepended pre-step listener and its early-started reads.

openMayNameUndone: a conversation’s first turn has no older turn to undo; any later turn may
